title: Add global editor plugin.

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve? Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/831 A full implementation of [my global plugin proposal](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/831#issuecomment-4333288607) which implement a global editor-only plugin system to have plugins load into all projects. ## Additional information This PR is based on all of my previous implementations combined into one for **easier testing**, while also separating them into different commits for **easy review**: - Closes #111193 - Closes #114823 - Closes #117450 ### What was added? An editor resource folder in the godot data directory to store global plugins. (e.g. `%APPDATA%/Godot/editor_resources/4.7/addons`)
A plugin tab in the editor settings for managing global plugins.
A new option in the plugin creation window to set whether the plugin is a project-only, editor-only, or both plugin. dd607cb9b6b1" />
An incompatible plugin will have an error shown on it and cannot be enabled.
A global editor directory is created in the godot data directory, and can be accessed in the filesystem. Also, there's a button at the top to toggle visibility of the editor directory. Other filesystem related editor for the editor directory was also added.
Editor Dir Dialog. Editor folders only visible if the "show editor directory" button from the filesystem dock is on.
File Dialog. The directory edit at the top can edit the path prefix between "editor://" and "res://". Not sure it this is going to break anything.
Asset Store global asset installer. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f7b90d20-a13f-46a8-b235-a685e2e5e640
### Usage To make a global plugin, go to `editor -> editor settings -> plugins` and create a plugin like you would normally do. In the plugin creation window theres a new option `editor compatibility` to choose whether the plugin is compatible with global plugin, normal project plugin, or both. In the filesystem click on `show editor directory` button to show the global plugin files. To install a global plugin, you can download a plugin normally from the Asset store, then before you install, select the "Install as Editor-wide" option. Alternatively you can download a plugin online, extract and place the plugin into the editor resource folder in the godot data directory (e.g. `%APPDATA%/Godot/editor_resources/4.7/addons`). Then turn on the plugin from `editor -> editor settings -> plugins`. > [!NOTE] > Some addons will work out of the box, but some will not, because they were referencing resources that is meant to be in `res://` instead of `editor://`. So some modification to the addon is needed. > ### TODO - [x] Add asset store editor plugin installer. - [ ] Move this to editor settings: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/111193#discussion_r2680062994 ### Technical overview As stated many times before, for the `editor://` path prefix implementation, ideally it would be better if https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/6307 implemented first, but it is also might be fine without it. A discussion for this is needed. ### Tested Operating system: - Windows 11. Tested by (me) @PiCode9560 - Linux. Tested by @rsubtil https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/111193#issuecomment-3728799690 - MacOS 15.7.2. Tested by @MartinDelille https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/111193#issuecomment-3769193986 - Android not tested yet.
